booking-availability.title: Booking availability
booking-availability.description: Set the local rules used to calculate possible meeting times.
booking-availability.calendar-description: Choose one home calendar and which calendars make time unavailable.
booking-availability.busy-calendars-help: Only the busy time is used in the preview. Calendar details stay private.
booking-availability.preview-safety: This is a calculation only. It does not hold, confirm, or write a booking.
booking-availability.busy-unavailable: Busy time could not be loaded. No times are available until it loads successfully.
booking-availability.no-busy: No busy time appears in this preview.
booking-availability.slots-unavailable: Calculated times are unavailable until the settings and busy time are valid.
booking-availability.no-slots: No times match these settings in the next seven days.
booking-availability.save-failed: Availability settings could not be saved.
